key_insight: SLAI T-Rex shows that trillion-parameter post-training on Ascend SuperPOD can be made practical through joint optimization of parallelism, communication, and kernel execution, then reused to build a domain-specialized OR model.
engineering_relevance: The paper is relevant because it demonstrates an end-to-end pathway for adapting GPU-era large-model training ideas to NPU supercomputers while preserving training stability and improving throughput.
method: Hierarchical optimization across model parallelism, computation-communication scheduling, and kernel execution
Post-training DeepSeek-V4 family on Ascend SuperPOD with full-parameter optimization
Build CPT and SFT pipelines for OR tasks using collected resources plus solver-verified synthetic data
evidence_signal: The optimized system reaches 34.22% MFU with a 2.93× improvement over the open-source baseline, and the specialized model attains 71.81% average zero-shot Pass@1 on evaluated OR tasks.
watch_item: Results are tightly coupled to the Ascend NPU stack and DeepSeek-V4 family, so portability to other hardware or model families may require substantial re-tuning.
paper_title: SLAI T-Rex: Full-Parameter Post-training of the DeepSeek-V4 Family on Ascend SuperPOD
